description: JavaScript demo for generating QR codes, including functions for rendering QR codes on canvas or SVG, and analyzing segments and Unicode characters.

methods.name: redrawQrCode
methods.description: Main function to generate and display QR code based on user input, handling both bitmap and SVG outputs, and updating statistics.

methods.name: getInputErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Determines the error correction level for QR code based on selected radio button.

methods.name: describeSegments
methods.description: Provides a string description of QR code segments' encoding mode.

methods.name: countUnicodeChars
methods.description: Counts Unicode code points in a UTF-16 string, throws error if invalid surrogate pairs.

methods.name: handleVersionMinMax
methods.description: Adjusts minimum and maximum QR code version inputs and triggers QR code redraw.
